result.finding: No servlet container required. The rabbitmq-sender is a standalone Spring Boot application with no web components — it has no HTTP endpoints, no web.xml, no servlet/filter implementations, and no spring-boot-starter-web or embedded server dependency. It runs as a plain JVM process and terminates after sending messages to Azure Service Bus.
evidence: No spring-boot-starter-web dependency in pom.xml (no embedded Tomcat/Jetty/Undertow)
No javax.servlet-api or jakarta.servlet-api dependency found
No WEB-INF/web.xml or META-INF/persistence.xml deployment descriptor
No @WebServlet, @WebFilter, or @WebListener annotations found in source code
No HttpServlet or Filter interface implementations found
Application packaging: standalone Spring Boot fat JAR (not WAR)
values: Deployment model: standalone Spring Boot JAR
